name: @fit/astryx-theme
description: Fit's custom Astryx themes — `fit` (Aurora-glass: electric-indigo accent, Manrope/Archivo) for the admin console, and `formacore` (Lime Block: charcoal ink canvas, one lime, Noto Sans Georgian) for the member portal.

scripts.build: echo '[@fit/astryx-theme] build: prebuilt themes are committed under dist/ — run `pnpm --filter @fit/astryx-theme theme:build` (needs Node >=22.13) to regenerate'
scripts.theme:build: pnpm run theme:build:fit && pnpm run theme:build:formacore
scripts.test: echo '[@fit/astryx-theme] test: nothing to do yet'
